title: blessed/admitted-bundle/v1
description: The manifest of a CLOSED ADMISSION BUNDLE. It records commitments to every input admission checked and the identity it selected. It is NOT a credential and NOT an authenticator: it is a plain caller-writable file, and recomputing its hashes proves only internal consistency. Anyone who can write it can write any admission_id they like. It is therefore never trusted on its own — render and apply re-run the same fail-closed verifier over the bundle's actual bytes, including re-verifying the candidate signature, before doing anything. Its value is that it names exactly which inputs an actionable stage must re-verify, so a later stage cannot be handed a different candidate, policy, receipt, or surface than the one admitted. This design assumes one continuous trusted execution boundary; moving a bundle through untrusted jobs or storage would require a receiver-authenticated signed or attested envelope, which is deliberately out of scope here.

admission_id.description: Digest over the canonical commitment set. Identifies the bundle; asserts nothing about its authenticity.

candidate_created_at.description: Carried VERBATIM from the candidate manifest's created_at, which is `format: date-time` with no further restriction. This field previously also demanded a Z suffix, which no upstream schema requires: a producer emitting a legal RFC3339 numeric offset (git's %cI does exactly that) produced a valid candidate that could never be admitted, because bundle-verify.sh binds this field to the candidate's value verbatim. The binding is the invariant worth keeping; the extra pattern only made the two contracts disagree.

receiver.description: The EXPLICITLY TRUSTED receiver repository and base commit. Surface, policy, and live state are read from tracked blobs at this SHA, never from a working copy that any caller could edit.

trust_store.description: Digest of the trust store admission used. The bytes are NOT carried in the bundle and must be supplied out-of-band to every later stage; this commitment is what proves the store they were given is the one that was admitted.

signature_verification.description: Actionable admission REQUIRES verified=true. There is no unsigned actionable path.
